words.intro: Every year of the club, kept in one place: the people who led it, the sessions, and the small moments in between. Oldest first, the way it happened.
words.thanks: To everyone who has led, mentored, organised or pitched in. None of this happens without you.
words.missing: Missing someone? Tell a lead, and they'll add them to the team or the contributors list.
words.nextText: The next chapter is written by whoever shows up. Come to a session, make your first pull request, and you're part of it.
